def body_cage(fr):

            b=n['boundary']; body=(b[0][0]//4,b[0][1]//4)
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; cage=(b[0][0]//4,b[0][1]//4)
    return body,cage
